text:
alex_marketing: Hey @runtime — we need a validated benchmark sweep for the launch materials. Goal: compare two quantized inference variants (int8 vs q4f16) on long-context prompts to surface cold-start and tail latency behavior. Please keep the runs reproducible and upload raw CSVs + traces.

Requirements: total ~1M tokens per variant (~25k requests), same RNG seed: 20240714, hardware: p4d, concurrency cap 32, streaming traces, 2-minute warmup, include token billing estimate column. Tag artifacts with marketing-launch-v1 and variant label.

Sample request to mirror:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-open-70b",
  "prompt_set": "long_tail_seeded_20240714",
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "temperature": 0.0
}
```

jamie_runtime: Got it. Quick Qs: 1) confirm we should run both variants on the same p4d cluster? 2) want any special rejection filtering? streaming traces add ~5-10% overhead.

alex_marketing: Yes same p4d for both. No extra filtering, but include a column for "decoding_retry_reason" if retries occurred. Streaming traces are important — use prod mode to match customer experience.

riley_eng: I'll submit the jobs. Concurrency=32, warmup=120s, seed=20240714. I'll attach the exact CLI in this thread and post job ids. We'll produce run.csv (schema below), traces.tar.gz, README.yml, and 50-sample QA JSONs.

riley_eng: CLI (audit):
```bash
redwood-cli jobs submit \n  --model redwood-open-70b \n  --variant int8 \n  --hardware p4d \n  --concurrency 32 \n  --seed 20240714 \n  --warmup 120 \n  --requests 25000 \n  --streaming true \n  --tag marketing-launch-v1:int8 \n  --output s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/int8/
```

deploy-bot: Job queued  job=job-2026-05-12-5001-int8 ETA ~3h

riley_eng: int8 started (job-2026-05-12-5001-int8). Posting live sampled metrics:
```
count, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cold_starts
500, 84, 221, 405, 2
2000, 88, 228, 430, 9
8000, 92, 240, 470, 28
```

alex_marketing: Please ensure run.csv includes these columns: request_id, model, variant, hardware, start_ts, end_ts, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, cold_start_bool, decoding_retry_reason, run_tag, billing_tokens_est.

jamie_runtime: Will do. We'll also drop a small README.yml with binary+commit, exact invocation, and RNG seed. ETA prelim results in ~48h.

riley_eng: int8 artifacts uploaded: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/int8/ (run.csv, traces.tar.gz, README.yml). job job-2026-05-12-5001-int8 completed.

alex_marketing: Thanks! Can you provide a one-line exec summary like: "int8: p50 Xms, p95 Yms, p99 Zms, cold-starts N" for comms? Also upload 50 sample input+output JSONs to s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/samples/.

jamie_runtime: Exec summary for int8: p50 86ms, p95 225ms, p99 412ms, cold-starts 26. Samples uploaded. Kicking q4f16 now with identical config. job=job-2026-05-12-5001-q4f16

riley_eng: q4f16 completed. Artifacts: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/q4f16/ (run.csv, traces.tar.gz, README.yml). Exec summary: q4f16: p50 118ms, p95 305ms, p99 610ms, cold-starts 41.

alex_marketing: These numbers look good for the launch narrative. Final asks: 1) add a tiny CSV slice with worst 100 requests (highest latency) across variants, 2) confirm there are no PII tokens in sample outputs (legal).

riley_eng: Added worst_requests.csv and ran a quick PII scan on samples (no hits). Files in s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/complete_artifacts/.

alex_marketing: Amazing 64f3fb Thanks everyone 389 Please @channel when the public launch doc is ready to consume the summary.
